summary: Snail, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Nasdaq deficiency letter for non-compliance with continued listing standards, including net income, market value, and stockholders' equity requirements. The company submitted a compliance plan, which Nasdaq accepted, granting an extension to September 22, 2026, to demonstrate compliance. Failure to do so may lead to delisting. No transaction or corporate event is announced; the filing is a routine disclosure of a listing standards matter. The company notes potential equity or debt transactions to regain compliance but no definitive plans exist. This is not a special situation; it is a routine regulatory notification.
